concept: Coding and Decoding in Fictitious Language
question: In a code language, 'make time' is coded as 'bo ho', 'time never stops' is coded as 'ho ru du', 'she stops work' is coded as 'vu du ya', and 'never make mistakes' is coded as 'ru bo tu'. What is the code for the word 'never'?
solution:
Given:

'make time' is coded as 'bo ho',

'time never stops' is coded as 'ho ru du',

'she stops work' is coded as 'vu du ya',

'never make mistakes' is coded as 'ru bo tu'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0ad336d9657832710fdc1ad7b3192daa407bd8785661fac0a4ae6f8011e3175.png] 

Here, 'never' will be coded as 'ru'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
